rationale: Anthony brings deep expertise in energy systems, AI/ML, and cyber-physical infrastructure from his PG&E background, while Raghavendra is actively building practical ML implementations across RAG and computer vision. Anthony's conviction that graph neural networks outperform LLMs for structured enterprise data aligns well with Raghavendra's focus on real-world AI applications, and both work in ML-research domains where they could explore how advanced analytics apply to infrastructure and sustainability problems.
intro_message: Anthony James, meet Raghavendra Dinesh — you both work in ML-research and practical AI implementations; Anthony's experience applying graph neural networks to energy and infrastructure problems could complement Raghavendra's hands-on work building ML systems in Python and TypeScript.
